description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, a Fragment subclass for displaying logs within an Android application. It manages a LogView inside a ScrollView, setting up view properties, padding, and a text change listener to keep the view scrolled to the bottom when new log entries are added.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays log messages in a LogView, using a ScrollView to enable scrolling, and ensures the log view scrolls to the bottom when new logs are added.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures a ScrollView containing a LogView, setting layout parameters, padding, typeface, gravity, and text appearance.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, adds a TextWatcher to keep the ScrollView scrolled down on text changes, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
